thresholds.rule: Stress score S = (SPX below 200d ? 1:0) + (HY OAS >= 4.0 ? 1:0) + (VIX >= 30 ? 1:0). Exposure tiers: S=0 -> 100% (FULL), S=1 -> 60% (REDUCED), S>=2 -> 25% (DEFENSIVE, floor — never 0%). Target list is always the top decile scaled by exposure; remainder is cash. Asymmetric hysteresis: de-risk applies immediately when S rises; re-risk moves at most one tier per rebalance and only when the lower S has held for 2 consecutive rebalances (current + prior).
